package com.example

import io.embrace.android.embracesdk.`internal`.config.instrumented.schema.RangeLocalConfig
import io.embrace.android.embracesdk.`internal`.config.remote.RemoteConfig

/**
 * Resolved range config.
 */
public interface RangeConfig {
    public val bounded: Int

    public val name: String
}

public inline fun RangeConfig(crossinline bounded: () -> Int = { 10 }, crossinline name: () -> String = { "abc" }): RangeConfig = object : RangeConfig {
    override val bounded: Int = bounded()

    override val name: String = name()
}

public fun resolveRange(local: RangeLocalConfig, remote: RemoteConfig?): RangeConfig = RangeConfig(
    bounded = { remote?.rangeBounded?.takeIf { it in 1..100 } ?: local.getBounded().takeIf { it in 1..100 } ?: 10 },
    name = { remote?.rangeName?.takeIf { it.length <= 5 } ?: "abc" },
)
